Episode 204. Declaration of War (1)
Underground, Zekma's 4th city, Usurok.
The owner of the 4th city, Great Combat King 'Gaila Tun', greeted Bibol Vermont, hiding his displeasure.
"Come in. Hmm, you could have just communicated. Why bother coming here?"
"Why did you do such a reckless thing?"
Bibol asked abruptly without even exchanging greetings. The Zekma nearby glared at him for his audacity as if a superior was scolding a subordinate.
"How dare you speak to Brother Gaila like that, you mere human. Just because we're trading with you, do you think you've become something more?"
"If you show such an attitude one more time, I'll send you straight to the blood factory."

"Firstly, I'm not a human and I don't have to be captured to be put in your food warehouse. These insignificant soldiers have no concept of interfering in the conversation of the superiors. This is a good example of why Zekma keeps failing, Great Combat King Gaila."
At Bibol's words, Gaila sighed.
"Leave."
"But brother Great Combat King, that man dares to...!"
"Ah, if I tell you to leave, then leave! Apologize to Bibol on your way out. And bring brother Shimat who's outside."
In the end, the soldiers offered a soulless apology to Bibol and left the throne room. Bibol looked at Gaila with an expressionless face.
"Did you call me, Brother Gaila?"
"Ah, Brother Shimat. You know, I don't like to use my brain much. I need your help. I don't know how to explain it to Bibol."
"I understand."
Great Combat King Gaila and First-Class Combat King Shimat.
It was decided that these two would handle all negotiations with the alliance in the future.

This was because there was no one else suitable for 'negotiations and cooperation' other than these two. Gaila was the gentlest of the Zekma, and Shimat was a brain that everyone had recognized even before the seal was lifted.
"I haven't heard an answer yet. We clearly gave advice, so why did such an absurd incident occur? As an ally, we must hear the story."
The absurd incident referred to the death of Dreke Hon and the annihilation of his fleet.
"We're sorry, Bibol. We're also currently devastated. However, we fully sympathize with the reason for the royal family's anger."

"Do you think it can be easily dismissed by saying you're sorry? Especially, Dreke Hon who died this time was the one who revived most of the Blue Plutonian buried we had by feeding him. We made him into a perfect state even before Bakarun Yung, who is evaluated as the strongest Great Combat King. Do you know why?"
Bakarun Yung was the wall Dreke and his colleagues wanted to overcome with their blood, and he was the Great Combat King of the first city.
"... I think it was because of the unique ability Brother Dreke had."

"That's right, a vampire ability! Just because of that. If we had that ability, we would have been able to easily and overwhelmingly dominate in the war against the ground forces in the future. Enemies less than 9 stars, no matter how many they were, would have been nothing more than your wonderful nutrients, and the blood absorbed like that would have filled the factory. But now it's all vanished."
"Well, yes. But considering that Brother Dreke died this time, doesn't it mean that vampirism isn't that strong? Of course, it's an incredible ability."
'Please shut up, Great Combat King Gaila. You called me to save words!'
At Gaila's answer, Shimat cursed inwardly.

"Jin Runcandel, we clearly said he was special. We said to avoid fighting him directly no matter what happens. There was even a record of the Great Combat King Rakiman. Isn't vampirism that strong? If I had that ability, we would already be pressuring Jin Runcandel and inducing a favorable deal. Even if he is not a threat, his colleagues and territories are not!"
This was why Bibol was so furious.
The royal family was planning to erode the ground based on Dreke's ability.

"Do you think Jifli or Kinzelo currently have a way to deal with Dreke's vampiric ability? No. Even if they do, they will also have to bear significant damage. How could you lose the most important card from the start?"
Gaila closed her mouth with a cough.

"Also, touching the Jo Dragon Castle without consulting us is displeasing. The empire's territory is the land our royal family must reclaim, yet you touched it to get more nutrients. How much are you ignoring us? Can Zekma conquer the ground alone?"

"As I said earlier, we fully admit our mistake, Bibol. Therefore, I think it's right to discuss the future rather than blaming it. You're not here to break the alliance with us or to receive some compensation."
I know you're angry, we will consult on everything going forward and take a humble stance, so let's stop here and think about the future. Shimat's intention was clear.
"Can we trust that such an incident will never occur again, Two King Shimat?"
"I promise, on behalf of both my comrade Gaila and myself. From now on, you will see our tribe, the Zechmeister, showing more respect towards Bifmentgar."

"If this turns out to be mere words again, we will immediately terminate the alliance. And you should train your subordinates. Every time I visit, I'm treated like an insignificant human or an insect... Supporting the Zechmeister under such treatment makes me feel skeptical."
"We will surely take measures for that as well."
"Good, I'll believe it for now."
It was a moment that was inevitably bitter for Shimat.
Until before Drak's death, it was the Zechmeister who held the upper hand in the alliance, but now it had reversed.
"First of all, I should ask what the Zechmeister plans to do next. Have you selected a Great Battle King to replace Drak?"
"In my opinion, it seems right for Shimat to take that position, given the warriors of the Hyun Il clan. Soon, one will be selected from their ranks."
"As you may know, the new Great Battle King of the Hyun Il clan will inherit part of the abilities that Drak possessed."
"Even if it's half the vampire ability, it's not valuable as a weapon of war. It's negligible for dealing with the monsters of the surface."
The Great Battle King of the Zechmeister is linked to the castle.
And since 'vampirism' was an ability initially granted to the castle, the next person to become the Great Battle King could also use this ability.

However, without the permission of Tushin in the process, the ability was only emulated to a certain extent. Therefore, until Tushin returned, the Great Battle King of the Fifth City was inevitably of a lower status.
"So, shouldn't we know where Tushin is? Then, the next Great Battle King of the Fifth City could also wield a power similar to Drak."
"We can only tell you the whereabouts of Tushin if we have tangible results, and we are sure we are a perfect alliance. Besides, you are not yet ready to meet him."
The reason the Zechmeister believed the imperial family's claim that they knew 'the whereabouts of Tushin' was simple.
It was because the imperial family had the seal and sword left by the previous Zechmeister Tushin.

-'We need to awaken the other Great Battle King comrades soon. We'll have to check other castles as soon as Rakiman's treatment is over. To counter the power of Jin Runcandel... at least Great Battle King Bakarun or his castle, or Tushin, must awaken.
-'Bakarun's castle is probably sealed like ours. But as for Tushin... didn't he suddenly disappear even when we were active?
-'Lately, I've been thinking that Tushin disappeared because he foresaw this sealing situation.
Shimat was recalling the conversation he had with Andolin in the past.
"As I suspected, our Patron God brother foresaw the sealing and went into hiding. But why did they leave their commandments and sword to those whose identities we can't discern......"
Just as the Great King is connected to the castle, the Patron God of our race is connected to the sword.
The sword shown by the royal family definitely had the energy of the Patron God, which meant the Patron God was alive and breathing.

"Our Patron God brother wouldn't have had those taken by them. If that were the case, the commandments would have been automatically destroyed, even if not the sword. There must be some meaning, but I can't make heads or tails of it."
Bivol laughed inwardly, reading Shimat's inner thoughts.

"......I understand. Anyway, one of the Hyunil tribe will become the Great King of the 5th City, and nothing has been decided about the ground invasion. However, we have decided to completely exclude the Vamel Alliance from the invasion targets for the time being."

"That's the right choice. Without the power of Drekk's bloodline in our current state, it's impossible to press the Vamel Alliance. You'll see, with dimensional movement and fleet alone, you won't even be a match. Moreover, it's a problem that the Record Magician is still tracking us. If you keep hitting the Vamel Alliance, you're bound to get caught."
Valeria still couldn't figure out the location of our castles. To the royal family, the biggest danger was her. As soon as Valeria figured out the location, Jin would personally destroy our base.
"What should we do then?"
"First, we will send back the Blue Plutonian tribe buriers."
"......You mean there were more Blue Plutonian tribe buriers?"
"Fortunately, we found new buriers this time."
That's impossible. The royal family was only adjusting so that we could gradually regain our old power. So that it wouldn't be too difficult for them to control us.
Shimat realized that fact but didn't add anything. Unaware, Gaila laughed as if it was good news.
"Oh! There were more of them! Then this time, can we bring up the power of our Bakarun brother!?"
"No, our thoughts are different. The Blue Plutonian tribe buriers we will provide this time, use them to operate the airborne fortress."
"Isn't it better to activate the airborne fortress after recovering Bakarun first?"

"Activate the airborne fortress first. And based on that fortress, I would recommend striking at Zipfel. That is, start a war with Zipfel. If you capture the Sun Priestess they possess, you can also get information about the Sun God."
Bivol turned around, saying that.
"Remember. If something absurd like Drekk's bloodline happens again this time, we will immediately stop supporting you."
